title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
authors: Hafner, Danijar and Pasukonis, Jurgis and Ba, Jimmy and Lillicrap, Timothy
source_finding: World-model prediction and imagined policy improvement can be combined in a working control system.
implementation_inspiration: Borrow the separation of dynamics, utility and control; qualify model fidelity before imagined learning.
limitation: Control results do not establish language-model transfer or feasibility on a laptop.

title: Successor Features for Transfer in Reinforcement Learning
source_finding: A linear reward feature decomposition permits reuse of policy-conditioned expected future features across reward functions.
implementation_inspiration: Define consequence features, task weights, continuation policy and generalized policy improvement explicitly.
limitation: Transfer assumptions include compatible dynamics, reward features and approximation quality.

title: Universal Successor Features Approximators
source_finding: Successor-feature approximation can condition on both task and policy representations.
implementation_inspiration: Log policy identities; compare a policy bank with a plan-conditioned predictor.
limitation: A goal embedding alone does not specify how later actions will be chosen.

title: Distributional Successor Features Enable Zero-Shot Policy Optimization
authors: Zhu, Chuning and Wang, Xinqi and Han, Tyler and Du, Simon S. and Gupta, Abhishek
source_finding: DiSPO models a distribution of achievable successor features and a policy for realizing outcomes supported by its dataset.
implementation_inspiration: Compare direct long-horizon consequence prediction with recursive latent rollouts.
limitation: Dataset support and reward representation still constrain what can be achieved.

title: Successor Features for Efficient Multisubject Controlled Text Generation
authors: Cao, Meng and Fatemi, Mehdi and Cheung, Jackie Chi Kit and Shabanian, Samira
source_finding: SF-GEN applies successor features to multiple text-generation controls while leaving the base language-model parameters unchanged.
implementation_inspiration: Include a frozen-language-model successor-feature baseline.
limitation: This is direct prior art; successor features in language generation are not a new Rineya invention.

title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
source_finding: A Transformer can model actions conditioned on trajectory history and desired return.
implementation_inspiration: Use return-conditioned behavior modeling as a policy baseline.
limitation: Conditioning on a desired return is not an action-conditioned world model.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning as One Big Sequence Modeling Problem
authors: Janner, Michael and Li, Qiyang and Levine, Sergey
source_finding: Trajectory Transformer models discretized trajectories and uses search to plan.
implementation_inspiration: Use typed trajectory slots and compare explicit search with direct scoring.
limitation: Tokenizing states, actions and rewards is established prior art, not evidence of causal understanding.

title: UniMASK: Unified Inference in Sequential Decision Problems
source_finding: Different masks over a trajectory can express multiple sequential inference tasks.
implementation_inspiration: Specify mask families separately for prediction, inverse modeling and retrospective diagnostics.
limitation: A convenient mask does not establish that its visible information exists at deployment.

title: Masked Trajectory Models for Prediction, Representation, and Control
authors: Wu, Philipp and Majumdar, Arjun and Stone, Kevin and Lin, Yixin and Mordatch, Igor and Abbeel, Pieter and Rajeswaran, Aravind
source_finding: Masked trajectory reconstruction supports forward, inverse and control uses within one network.
implementation_inspiration: Compare causal and plan-conditioned masks without changing information budgets.
limitation: Continuous-control results do not establish faithful multi-step language reasoning.

title: Learning Action Representations for Reinforcement Learning
authors: Chandak, Yash and Theocharous, Georgios and Kostas, James and Jordan, Scott and Thomas, Philip
source_finding: Learned action representations can exploit structure in large discrete action spaces.
implementation_inspiration: Represent operator, arguments and executor semantics rather than a free-standing action name.
limitation: Similar action embeddings need not imply equivalent effects in every state.

title: Mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model
source_finding: MuZero learns quantities needed for planning rather than requiring full observation reconstruction.
implementation_inspiration: Test a task-sufficient consequence model against a richer state predictor.
limitation: Predicting reward and value is not itself a novel architecture.

title: DeepMDP: Learning Continuous Latent Space Models for Representation Learning
source_finding: Reward and latent-transition prediction give a model-based representation-learning objective.
implementation_inspiration: Retain transition structure in addition to utility supervision.
limitation: Theoretical guarantees depend on assumptions not automatically satisfied by hidden LLM states.

title: Learning Invariant Representations for Reinforcement Learning without Reconstruction
authors: Zhang, Amy and McAllister, Rowan and Calandra, Roberto and Gal, Yarin and Levine, Sergey
source_finding: Behaviorally relevant state representations can suppress irrelevant observational detail without reconstructing all pixels.
implementation_inspiration: Test nuisance invariance while protecting distinctions needed by different goals.
limitation: Task-specific invariance can erase features needed by a later task.

title: Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding
authors: van den Oord, Aaron and Li, Yazhe and Vinyals, Oriol
source_finding: Predictive contrastive objectives learn representations from future observations.
implementation_inspiration: Try contrastive consequence targets with carefully constructed same-state alternatives.
limitation: Naive negatives can penalize two genuinely equivalent successful outcomes.

title: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
authors: van den Oord, Aaron and Vinyals, Oriol and Kavukcuoglu, Koray
source_finding: A learned discrete codebook can represent latent data structure.
implementation_inspiration: Compare continuous consequences, train-only clustering and vector quantization.
limitation: A codebook does not automatically discover useful or human-interpretable reward categories.

title: VICReg: Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
authors: Bardes, Adrien and Ponce, Jean and LeCun, Yann
source_finding: Variance and covariance regularization can accompany an invariance objective to discourage collapsed embeddings.
implementation_inspiration: Use explicit anti-collapse diagnostics before adding a codebook.
limitation: A noncollapsed representation can still be irrelevant to decisions.

title: Diversity is All You Need: Learning Skills without a Reward Function
source_finding: Diverse behaviors can be learned through an intrinsic information objective rather than task reward labels.
implementation_inspiration: Use behavior diversity for transition coverage, then separately ground utility.
limitation: Intrinsic objectives are still design choices; unsupervised structure does not determine human preferences.

title: Generalized Decision Transformer for Offline Hindsight Information Matching
authors: Furuta, Hiroki and Matsuo, Yutaka and Gu, Shixiang Shane
source_finding: Future trajectory statistics can provide alternative conditioning signals for sequential behavior modeling.
implementation_inspiration: Compare consequence-summary conditioning with scalar return conditioning.
limitation: Hindsight information must not be presented as prospectively available evidence.

title: RUDDER: Return Decomposition for Delayed Rewards
source_finding: Return decomposition addresses difficult delayed-credit settings.
implementation_inspiration: Study long-distance attribution without double-counting terminal reward.
limitation: Predictive attribution is not by itself a causal effect estimate.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
source_finding: Comparisons between behaviors can train a reward model for policy learning.
implementation_inspiration: Offer preference pairs as one sparse grounding route.
limitation: Preference noise and the intended objective must remain separately audited.

title: Let's Verify Step by Step
source_finding: Process supervision distinguishes intermediate reasoning feedback from final-answer supervision.
implementation_inspiration: Evaluate verifier-grounded intermediate consequences alongside terminal correctness.
limitation: A learned process score must not become its own independent evaluation oracle.

title: When to Trust Your Model: Model-Based Policy Optimization
authors: Janner, Michael and Fu, Justin and Zhang, Marvin and Levine, Sergey
source_finding: Short model rollouts provide a practical way to limit the effects of model error.
implementation_inspiration: Gate imagined updates behind short-horizon fidelity and real-state re-anchoring.
limitation: A successful control recipe is not a guarantee against language-world model exploitation.

title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
source_finding: Offline value learning must address distribution shift and overestimation outside data support.
implementation_inspiration: Track candidate support and include conservative value baselines.
limitation: An uncertainty penalty without validation is not a certified conservative bound.

title: A Distributional Perspective on Reinforcement Learning
authors: Bellemare, Marc G. and Dabney, Will and Munos, Remi
source_finding: Predicting a return distribution exposes information hidden by its mean.
implementation_inspiration: Distinguish aleatoric outcome variation from uncertainty about model parameters.
limitation: Marginal return distributions do not establish joint multi-objective or multi-step dependence.

title: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles
authors: Lakshminarayanan, Balaji and Pritzel, Alexander and Blundell, Charles
source_finding: Independent predictors provide a practical uncertainty-estimation baseline.
implementation_inspiration: Use small independent heads or models, then test calibration and coverage.
limitation: Agreement can coexist with a shared blind spot.

title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
authors: Gao, Leo and Schulman, John and Hilton, Jacob
source_finding: Optimizing a proxy reward more strongly can separate proxy improvement from actual quality.
implementation_inspiration: Measure evaluator exploitability as candidate search width grows.
limitation: A higher predicted utility is not evidence of better real outcomes.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
source_finding: Low-rank trainable updates provide a parameter-efficient adaptation mechanism.
implementation_inspiration: Compare bounded adapters with a frozen-backbone sidecar.
limitation: Few trainable parameters do not guarantee preservation of existing behaviors.

title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
source_finding: Quantized frozen weights can reduce the memory cost of adapter tuning.
implementation_inspiration: Treat quantized loading as a separately qualified memory option.
limitation: Exact deployment arithmetic and small-delta fidelity must be checked on Rineya.

title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
source_finding: Long-context evaluation should test more than a single simple retrieval behavior.
implementation_inspiration: Separate dependency distance, distractors, aggregation and horizon length.
limitation: Good text-context performance does not establish action planning competence.

title: LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding
source_finding: Multiple long-context task types provide broader coverage than one metric.
implementation_inspiration: Use a budgeted external context suite after synthetic transition gates.
limitation: Benchmark access, licenses and contamination still require dataset-specific review.

title: TextWorld: A Learning Environment for Text-based Games
source_finding: Text-based interactive worlds provide controllable sequential-action tasks.
implementation_inspiration: Introduce external environments after exact synthetic snapshots work.
limitation: Natural-language observations introduce aliasing and partially observed state.

title: ALFWorld: Aligning Text and Embodied Environments for Interactive Learning
source_finding: Text and embodied tasks can share goals and interaction structure.
implementation_inspiration: Evaluate transfer from symbolic tasks to a richer text-action environment.
limitation: Success on the text setting does not establish visual or physical competence.

title: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
source_finding: A grounded web-shopping environment exposes multi-step decisions and task rewards.
implementation_inspiration: Use a sandbox benchmark, never real purchases, for later agent evaluation.
limitation: A benchmark simulator is not an authorization to act on real accounts.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
source_finding: Aggregate RL claims need uncertainty-aware evaluation across tasks and runs.
implementation_inspiration: Preserve paired parent outcomes and independent training seeds.
limitation: A toy run or a few seeds cannot certify a small practical gain.

title: Hindsight Experience Replay
source_finding: Achieved outcomes can support goal relabeling under suitable task semantics.
implementation_inspiration: Reuse transitions under valid alternative preference weights.
limitation: Relabeling cannot change what physically happened or cross sealed splits.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
source_finding: Self-supervised video representations can be connected to action-conditioned prediction and planning.
implementation_inspiration: Study visual latent targets only after a language/symbolic control benefit is established.
limitation: The reported scale and training resources are not the proposed laptop recipe.

title: DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning
authors: Zhou, Gaoyue and Pan, Hengkai and LeCun, Yann and Pinto, Lerrel
source_finding: Pretrained visual features can support learned latent dynamics and planning.
implementation_inspiration: Prefer frozen visual encoders over pixel generation for a later compact variant.
limitation: A chosen visual representation may omit a task-critical state variable.

title: From Word to World: Can Large Language Models be Implicit Text-based World Models?
source_finding: Language-world modeling can be evaluated by prediction fidelity, scaling behavior and downstream agent utility.
implementation_inspiration: Use independent fidelity and actual-control endpoints.
limitation: Do not repeat unverified percentage gains or venue claims from earlier brainstorming.

title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
source_finding: Dense hierarchical self-supervision offers additional ideas for predictive representations.
implementation_inspiration: Track multi-level targets and visual tokenizers as later reading.
limitation: Newer representation results do not prove the proposed Rineya consequence geometry.

title: Attention Is All You Need
source_finding: Attention provides a sequence-modeling mechanism with parallel training computations.
implementation_inspiration: Reuse attention while specifying exactly which information each query can access.
limitation: Parallel tensor operations do not remove environment causality or combinatorial search.

title: torch.nn.Transformer documentation
source_finding: Attention masks are part of the API contract and conventions differ across attention interfaces.
implementation_inspiration: Test blocked-versus-allowed Boolean semantics against the installed version.
limitation: Documentation versions and native Rineya attention kernels may differ.

title: Qwen3 model documentation
source_finding: The documented model API provides the stock-model reference for embeddings and model outputs.
implementation_inspiration: Use it as an interface reference, then qualify the actual Rineya implementation.
limitation: Stock Qwen3 compatibility is not proof of custom checkpoint compatibility.

title: Gymnasium Env API
source_finding: The environment interface distinguishes true termination from time-limit truncation.
implementation_inspiration: Record both flags and create explicit reproducible snapshot contracts.
limitation: A seed is not a complete snapshot of an arbitrary external environment.
